notes: No loop in the reached sources; the one while is the ABI encoding of a one-element address[] for claimRewards (P7). The Initializable ERC-7201 slot is printed as 0x111f...aa0 * 3600 (P1, same as c00102). Functions are short; ERC4626/permit/upgrade paths checked by reading.
summary: Short and faithful text with no loops; readability costs are the expanded ray mulDiv arithmetic, immutables as 0 and the P1-factored Initializable slot.
